findings.finding: The operational guide and installed skill omit that simultaneous standalone MCP sessions collide on the app-global Ctrl+Alt+Shift+F11 emergency registration. The canonical assessment records this limit, but agents following the entrypoints can still attempt concurrent standalone ownership.
findings.recommendation: Document the standalone F11 collision in both entrypoints and direct concurrent agents to the existing authorized GUI bridge when appropriate; do not imply multiple standalone sessions are supported.
findings.acceptance: Both entrypoints state the collision and describe the GUI-connected ownership path.

findings.finding: The generic acknowledgement caveat omits the demonstrated Busy routing_input case: a denied attempt may return isError:false with a Routing unavailable status and no delivery/native output.
findings.recommendation: Explain that processed Busy denial is not successful delivery; inspect routing_state/status and do not retry as if the input was delivered.
findings.acceptance: The agent instructions identify this nonfatal processed ACK and tell agents to inspect status before proceeding.

checks.scope_claims: Bounded scope is truthful: no full Ultra/P1, hardware, desktop-wide or same-process isolation claim; simultaneous standalone limitation is recorded in canonical assessment; i686 controller built but not run; footer crop documented; quarantine scoped to touched targets; two clean Stop/restart sessions bounded.
